attributes.title: PSCA Conference 2026: Empowered Counselors. Thriving Students.
attributes.series: Pennsylvania School Counselors Association Annual Conference
attributes.venue: The Penn Stater Hotel & Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Pennsylvania School Counselors Association holds its 2026 annual conference from December 2 to 4 at The Penn Stater Hotel & Convention Center in State College. The theme is "Empowered Counselors. Thriving Students." Carolyn Stone opens with a December 2 pre-conference on legal literacy and ethical practice in school counseling, John Hodge gives the December 3 keynote, and Terri Tchorzynski closes on December 4 with a session on building proactive systems in school counseling programs.

The conference page lists Act 48 hours for Pennsylvania educators, NCC hours and continuing education units through Lindenwood University, with 6 CEUs awarded for the annual conference. The number of NCC hours is not stated; syllabus and CEU questions go to Lindenwood's K-12 professional development office.

The full conference costs $350 for professional members, $250 for student, retiree and lifetime members and $450 for non-members, with a $50 discount for early registration that ended October 15. A Thursday-only pass, the pre-conference and the recognition dinner are sold separately. The page notes that online registration has closed but on-site registration is accepted. The hotel block at $154 per night closed on November 2, and refunds are not available after that date.
